set.body:
Requested by a downstream desktop host (eyes4s Studio), stated generically. Found while building a canvas host on the 56506d2 interaction pieces.

Problem
StrokeCasing (56506d2) is honoured on lines and paths but not on point marks or discs. A hollow or outlined point drawn over a busy background (image, density field) cannot get a contrasting casing, so hosts replace each point with a many-segment ring path to get one, which multiplies primitive count.

Scope
Honour StrokeCasing for point shapes (circle, square, diamond, triangle, ...) and disc/ellipse primitives, in batches and singly, on every backend.

Acceptance criteria
1. A cased hollow circle point renders casing under the stroke on JavaFX, SVG and Canvas, matching the path casing geometry within a device pixel.
2. Batched points keep one primitive per batch (no per-mark path expansion).
3. Casing is decorative and does not enlarge the picking footprint, for point marks, discs and paths alike. Preserve the existing path picking contract.
